title: On Climbing the north face in one day
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：climb　|　正文 367 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 climb 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the porter ① climbed the north face in one day for the whole place, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the porter ② climbs the north face in one day without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ climb the north face in one day at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ climbed the north face in one day before — a line in the journal for August 1945 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Climbing the north face in one day for the whole place, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ climb into the loft after dark without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Climb into the loft after dark at once and never mention it again.

By 1958 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new visitor from the next coast ⑧ climbs into the loft after dark for the whole place every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cove, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ climbed the north face in one day again when nobody else would.

⑩ To climb the north face in one day, my mother said in 1963, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the coast remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the coast forgets, somebody climbs the north face in one day without a word of thanks again and somebody must climb the north face in one day for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 攀登（一般过去式 climbed the north face in one day：1951 年挑夫头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 攀登（一般现在 climbs the north face in one day：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 攀登（不定式 to climb the north face in one day：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 攀登（过去完成时 had climbed the north face in one day：1945 年八月的行记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 攀登（动名词 climbing the north face in one day 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 爬上（climb into the loft after dark：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去爬上天黑后爬进阁楼）
G. v. 爬上（climb into the loft after dark：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 攀登（后段两处：新来的游客照例 climbs into the loft after dark，而母亲又一次 climbed the north face in one day）

answers.why: climb 意为“攀登”，1951 年挑夫替所有人攀登一天之内攀上北坡，那是海岸里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 climbed。
climb 意为“攀登”，自那以后挑夫不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 climbs。
climb 意为“攀登”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯攀登一天之内攀上北坡”，此处为不定式 to climb the north face in one day。
climb 意为“攀登”，行记里 八月 那行字说明早在 1958 年之前就有人攀登过，故用过去完成时 had climbed。
climb 意为“攀登”，挑夫说“攀登一天之内攀上北坡这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 climbing the north face in one day 作主语。
climb 意为“爬上”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去爬上天黑后爬进阁楼”，should ever 之后用原形 climb into the loft after dark。
climb 意为“爬上”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻爬上天黑后爬进阁楼（climb into the loft after dark at once），以后再也不要提起。
climb 意为“攀登”，新来的游客每个星期都照例爬上天黑后爬进阁楼，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 climbs。
climb 意为“攀登”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人攀登一天之内攀上北坡，用一般过去式 climbed 叙述。
climb 意为“攀登”，结尾那句是母亲 1963 年的话：要攀登一天之内攀上北坡，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和海岸记住的那一件。

Three weeks on, the porter still climbs the north face in one day without a word of thanks without being asked.
My mother said later that to climb the north face in one day at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had climbed the north face in one day long before 1958, and the line in the journal for August proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 climb 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the porter climbed the north face in one day for the whole place, and nobody in the coast forgot it.
Even now the porter climbs the north face in one day without a word of thanks whenever the coast asks.
Climbing the north face in one day for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever climb into the loft after dark without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next coast climbs into the loft after dark for the whole place every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother climbed the north face in one day again, and the coast remembered that half.
